label: PanTHERIA: a species-level database of life history, ecology, and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals (WR05 version, Aug 2008)
bibliographic_citation: Jones KE, Bielby J, Cardillo M, Fritz SA, O'Dell J, Orme CDL, Safi K, Sechrest W, Boakes EH, Carbone C, Connolly C, Cutts MJ, Foster JK, Grenyer R, Habib M, Plaster CA, Price SA, Rigby EA, Rist J, Teacher A, Bininda-Emonds ORP, Gittleman JL, Mace GM, Purvis A (2009) PanTHERIA: a species-level database of life history, ecology, and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals. Ecology 90:2648. Ecological Archives E090-184.

counts.description: rows for family Elephantidae (Elephas maximus, Loxodonta africana, L. cyclotis)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled species means: adult body mass (5-1_AdultBodyMass_g), basal metabolic rate (18-1_BasalMetRate_mLO2hr), head–body length, life-history and range variables for 5,416 mammal species (Wilson & Reeder 2005 taxonomy).
role: adult body mass and basal metabolic rate across mammals, including elephants and whales, for the gravitational size-limit and buoyancy claims (thompson1917-ch02-03, ch02-04, ch02-10, ch02-12)
notes: License is not stated on the Ecological Archives page; ESA data papers of this period were distributed for scholarly use without an explicit license.
